name: greenlight/greenlight
description: A test framework for PHP 8.4+ with typed attributes, parallel execution, flat memory use, and lifecycle-safe test doubles.

suggest.ext-pcntl: Scans Hyperf classes before 'HyperfPlugin' starts a worker
suggest.ext-swoole: Runs 'HyperfPlugin' workers and test attempts in Hyperf coroutines
suggest.fidry/cpu-core-counter: Improves the 'auto' worker count across platforms and on systems with cgroup limits
suggest.hyperf/di: Scans Hyperf classes and generates AOP proxies for the 'HyperfPlugin' bridge
suggest.hyperf/framework: Provides the Hyperf 3.2 application runtime that 'HyperfPlugin' requires
suggest.laravel/framework: Provides the complete Laravel 13 framework that LaravelPlugin requires
suggest.phpstan/extension-installer: Registers the bundled PHPStan extension automatically
suggest.phpstan/phpstan: Type-checks extension matcher calls and data providers with the bundled 'extension.neon' file
suggest.psr/container: Connects a PSR-11 application container to Greenlight through 'Psr11Plugin'
suggest.psr/http-message: Provides the PSR-7 request and response interfaces that HttpHarness requires
suggest.psr/http-server-handler: Provides the PSR-15 request handler interface that Psr15Plugin requires
suggest.rector/rector: Converts PHPUnit test classes to Greenlight with the bundled 'PhpUnitToGreenlightRector' rule
suggest.symfony/framework-bundle: Enables container service injection into kernel-aware Symfony tests through the 'SymfonyPlugin' bridge
suggest.tempest/framework: Enables discovery, configuration, container injection, and reset-safe tests through the 'TempestPlugin' bridge

scripts-descriptions.check: Runs static analysis, tests, and the memory gate.
scripts-descriptions.code-style:check: Checks code style without changes to files.
scripts-descriptions.memory-gate: Checks for memory growth during a long test run.
scripts-descriptions.prose:check: Checks technical prose for mechanical errors.
scripts-descriptions.prose:review: Reports possible technical prose problems for manual review.
scripts-descriptions.rector:check: Checks if Rector can change the PHP code.
scripts-descriptions.rector:fix: Applies Rector changes to the PHP code.
scripts-descriptions.static-analysis: Runs all static analysis checks with the local CI lock.
scripts-descriptions.static-analysis:unlocked: Runs all static analysis checks without the local CI lock.
scripts-descriptions.tests: Runs the complete test suite with the local CI lock.
scripts-descriptions.tests:coverage: Runs the complete test suite with coverage and the local CI lock.
scripts-descriptions.tests:coverage:unlocked: Runs the complete test suite with coverage without the local CI lock.
scripts-descriptions.workflow-shell:check: Checks shell commands in GitHub Actions workflows.
